nodes.text: [i]Six guests, six chairs. And from the dark behind the last chair, something rises to its feet: tall, hunched, glittering, with one great shoulder turned toward the table.[/i]

nodes.speaker: The Empty Table
nodes.text: ...You came. All of you came. Then why does it feel like I'm being turned away?
[i]It is the thing she was afraid of all along: the cold shoulder. It will always show you its side. But anything that turns away has a back, and the guests are warm, and so are you.[/i]
